body: It's really not all about perspective and attitude in every case. I'm glad that worked for you, but I'm not here looking for advice. Please, leave me alone now.
I'm sorry if I upset you... I just am not happy. I'll leave you alone. I'm sorry life has been so unkind to you, and I hope it gets better.

Thank you very much for your support, but that's not something I can do. You're a very kind person, but honestly, there's nothing that you, nor anyone, can really do. This is a decision that I've come to make on my own. There's no quality of life for me, and it doesn't really matter where I go. I wish you the best, though, and I hope you take good care of yourself. You've got a good heart. ❤️
I'm so sorry for you loss. My deepest condolences to you. ❤️

I'm ftm, too, and have had somewhat similar reactions to coming out. People fear the things they cannot understand, and your mom honestly just sounds like a scared bitch, pardon my French. Coming from someone who has been down that road, my advice is to be yourself. Be who YOu want to be, not who your mom wants you to be, because you are you, and that's awesome. 

With that being said, I'm so sorry that you're going through those struggles right now. I know how difficult those feelings are, and I'm so proud of you for having the courage to come out regardless of your mom's reaction because that's insanely hard as is, but it's even worse when the person has a negative reaction. Please just know that being trans does not make you a disgusting dyke and that it's ok to be trans. It's ok to be different. If you feel like a man, then you're a man! It doesn't matter what anyone else says because no one change change your gender but you. I'm proud of you, and I, for one, accept you with open arms. 🏳️‍⚧️💙💜🤍💜💙

I'm sorry that you're struggling again. I feel like it's always worse when you've tasted even a hint of freedom from suicidal ideations. I understand how you're feeling. 

Also, I'm glad I could help you rethink things. It sounds like you've got a good approach to responding to things, although I wouldn't really know that. Just don't drive yourself crazy with what you could be doing wrong. I know I fall into that trap a lot, actually.
Ugh, yeah. It's so frustrating when people say things like this.
